agency.label: Design studio
agency.description: A design studio in the Atelier library: near-white paper, ink buttons, big rounded cards and sections that turn over to black.

children.text: A design studio with a love of detail.
We make websites, visual identities and graphic design for brands that care about quality.

values.alt: Hands turning the pages of a printed proof beside a tablet
The Fjord Health website open on a laptop

children.text: A new website and visual identity

values.alt: A phone showing the Holm Partners website

children.text: Design is not about being loud.
And leaving only what is right.
We design and build websites with a focus on calm, clarity and good digital craft.
From the first sketches to the finished site we work closely with you on something that feels considered and lasts. We build on the platform that makes sense for you, and say which.
Graphic work that makes your visual expression clear and complete.
Presentations, print and digital assets that hang together and work in practice. A single job, or a design partner on call.
A direction that feels right, turned into an identity that works on every surface.
From the first thoughts to a finished, thorough expression, made with care and an eye for the small details.
Mørk & Lund is a digital design studio built on a love of digital design.
We work with websites, visual identities and graphic design, with a focus on good craft, a calm process and the small details that make a difference.

values.alt: A desk by the studio window, with a plant and a laptop
A portrait of Ida Mørk

children.text: Ida has more than five years of agency experience as a digital designer, specialising in visual identities and websites. She works strategically and as a whole, from the first idea to the finished implementation.
With a sharp eye and years of working closely with clients, she turns complex needs into clear, thorough design: digital worlds that are both visually precise and thought through in use.

values.alt: A portrait of Anders Lund

children.text: Anders has spent many years in digital design, most recently leading marketing design at a software company, where he shaped its visual identity across platforms, website and marketing.
He combines design and web development with a sharp eye for structure, detail and the experience of using the thing, and turns design into scalable, finished websites of high quality.

values.alt: Wireframes drawn on a tablet

children.text: “It has been a good and professional collaboration from day one. Mørk & Lund were structured, proactive and open, with an eye for our brand, our audience and ease of use. Having design and development in one place made it easy for us to run the site ourselves afterwards.”

values.alt: A hand sketching screens on paper

children.text: “I gave them creative freedom and had little idea which direction they would take. The result was thorough and very detailed, the process easy and the prices fair. They have my warmest recommendation.”
The people you talk to are the people who design and build your site. No go-betweens, and nothing lost on the way.
Design and development in one place
We take the whole process from the first sketch to the finished code, so the site looks exactly as designed.
We have worked in agencies and in-house, so we know what the designer and the client each need from a collaboration.
We are there after the launch too. Questions, corrections or new ideas for the site: we help you on.
Tell us a little about your project, your needs and your ambitions. Then we take a no-strings talk about how we can best help.
We reply within a working day.

pricing.label: Packages and prices
pricing.description: A fixed-price service page in the Tally library: night bands, three package cards, big headings over plain lists, and a page of questions.

children.text: One fixed price for the whole shop. No hourly rates, no surprises. All prices exclude VAT.
For a single product or a small range, up to five.
Home page and one strong product page
For up to 50 products, or for selling subscriptions.
For running ads from day one.
Tested events, so you can see what the ads sell
Product copy written for ads, up to five products
Three ad texts and one video script
An ad plan for the first 30 days
For a shop that already lives somewhere else.
Products, variants and images, up to 100 products
Old addresses forwarded, so search engines and customers find the new shop
PNG or SVG if you can. No logo yet? I will set your name in a typeface that suits you.
At least three of each product, sharp and in daylight. A new phone takes fine pictures.
Name, price, variants such as size and colour, weight and stock. For Grow, in one spreadsheet.
For Start, a few lines about each product and I will finish them. For Grow, finished product texts, and I will write the home page and the collections.
Three to five lines on who you are and why you sell what you sell.
Which carriers and prices you want, your returns policy and your company details for the legal pages.
I set up the shop myself. If you have a domain or an old shop, I will need access to them.
Delivery time starts the day your deposit is paid and I have everything.
Small changes to words, pictures and prices, up to one hour a month
Basket, payment and shipping checked every month
An answer within one working day
A look at your sales every month: where do customers drop off?
One improvement a month, such as the product page, the basket or an offer, up to three hours in all
No lock-in. You can also run the shop yourself.
Half when you order. The rest before the shop opens.
The shop is handed over before it opens, so it is entirely yours.
The first three get 20% off, in return for letting me show the shop as a case.
No. Every price on this page excludes VAT, which is added to the invoice.
You do. The shop is built on your own account and is yours from the day it opens.
Is the platform’s monthly fee included?
No. You pay your shop platform directly, and I help you choose the plan that fits.
Half when you order, and the rest before the shop opens.
How fast will the shop be ready?
Start takes 7 working days and Grow takes 12, counted from the day your deposit is paid and I have everything.
Start includes one round of changes and Grow includes two. Anything beyond that is priced before I begin.
I already have a shop. Can you move it?
Yes. Moving is an add-on that brings across your products, your customer list and your old addresses.
Can you improve the shop I already have?
Often, yes. Book 15 minutes and we will look at it together.
Yes. Subscriptions are part of Grow, so customers can keep buying without coming back to order.
What happens once the shop is open?
You can run it yourself, or choose Care, which keeps it updated and checked every month.
The first three customers get 20% off, in return for letting me show the shop as a case.
Choose Start for a few products, and Grow for a larger range or subscriptions. If you are unsure, ask me.

pricing-ja.description: 固定料金のサービスページを日本語で。Tallyライブラリで、夜色の帯、3枚の料金カード、大きな見出し、よくある質問を組みました。

children.text: ネットショップ制作の料金。
ショップ一式を固定料金で。時間課金も、追加請求もありません。表示価格はすべて税込です。
商品数が少ないお店に。5商品まで対応します。
ブランドに合わせたテーマ設定
トップページと商品ページ
クレジットカードとPayPay決済
特定商取引法などの法定ページ
50商品まで。定期購入を始めたいお店にも。
スタートの内容すべて
定期購入でリピートを促進
どちらのプランにも追加できます。
公開初日から広告を出したい方に。
MetaピクセルとコンバージョンAPI
計測テスト済みで、広告の成果が見える
広告向けの商品説明文、5商品まで
広告文3本と動画台本1本
最初の30日間の広告プラン
商品、バリエーション、画像、100商品まで
旧URLの転送設定で、検索順位の評価を引き継ぎ
PNGかSVGが理想です。ロゴがなければ、お店に合う書体で店名をお作りします。
1商品につき3枚以上。明るい場所で撮影したものをお願いします。最近のスマホで十分です。
商品名、価格、サイズや色などのバリエーション、重さ、在庫数。グロースは1つの表にまとめてください。
スタートは各商品の説明を数行いただければ仕上げます。グロースは商品説明をご用意いただき、トップページとコレクションはこちらで書きます。
どんな方が、なぜその商品を販売しているのかを3〜5行で。
配送会社と送料、返品条件、特定商取引法の表記に載せる事業者情報。
ショップはこちらで開設します。ドメインや既存のショップがあれば、ログイン情報をご共有ください。
納期は、着手金のお支払いとご用意いただくものがそろった日から数えます。
テーマとアプリの更新
文章、画像、価格の小さな修正、月1時間まで
カート、決済、配送の動作確認を毎月
毎月の売上分析:お客様はどこで離脱しているか
商品ページ、カート、キャンペーンなどの改善を月1回、合計3時間まで
契約期間の縛りはありません。ご自身での運営も可能です。
着手金として50%、残りはショップ公開前に。
ショップは公開前にお引き渡しするので、すべてお客様のものです。
先着3名様は20%オフ。その代わり、制作事例として掲載させてください。
ネットショップ制作の費用相場はいくらですか?
基本機能のみの小規模なショップで30万〜100万円が一般的な目安です。こちらはプランごとの固定料金で、スタートは税込298,000円からです。
はい。このページの価格はすべて税込です。
制作費のほかに毎月かかる費用はありますか?
ショッププラットフォームの月額料金と決済手数料はお客様のご負担です。保守は任意で、必要な場合のみご契約いただけます。
ECサイトの制作期間はどれくらいですか?
スタートは7営業日、グロースは12営業日です。着手金のお支払いと、ご用意いただくものがそろった日から数えます。
どのプラットフォームで作りますか?
主にShopifyで構築します。ご希望があれば、最初の相談でお聞かせください。
ショップの所有権は誰にありますか?
お客様です。お客様のアカウントで構築し、公開時点からすべてお客様のものになります。
支払い方法を教えてください。
ご注文時に50%、残りをショップ公開前にお支払いいただきます。
修正は何回までできますか?
スタートは1回、グロースは2回です。それを超える場合は、作業前にお見積もりをお伝えします。
BASEやSTORESから移転できますか?
はい。ショップ移転のオプションで、商品、顧客リスト、旧URLの転送まで対応します。
定期購入のショップは作れますか?
はい。定期購入はグロースに含まれています。
公開後の運営はどうなりますか?
ご自身で運営できるようお引き渡しします。更新や毎月の確認を任せたい場合は、保守プランをお選びください。
どのプランを選べばよいですか?
商品数が少なければスタート、商品が多い場合や定期購入を始める場合はグロースが合います。迷ったらお気軽にご相談ください。
どのプランが合うか、迷ったら。

structuredData.name: ネットショップ制作の料金プラン|固定料金で税込298,000円から|plainshop
structuredData.description: ネットショップ制作を固定料金で。5商品までのスタートは税込298,000円、7営業日で公開します。時間課金も追加請求もありません。ECサイト制作の費用、納期、公開後の保守までご案内します。

offers.name: スタート
offers.description: 商品数が少ないお店に。5商品まで対応します。

offers.name: グロース
offers.description: 50商品まで。定期購入を始めたいお店にも。

mainEntity.name: ネットショップ制作の費用相場はいくらですか?

acceptedAnswer.text: 基本機能のみの小規模なショップで30万〜100万円が一般的な目安です。こちらはプランごとの固定料金で、スタートは税込298,000円からです。
はい。このページの価格はすべて税込です。

mainEntity.name: 制作費のほかに毎月かかる費用はありますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: ショッププラットフォームの月額料金と決済手数料はお客様のご負担です。保守は任意で、必要な場合のみご契約いただけます。

mainEntity.name: ECサイトの制作期間はどれくらいですか?

acceptedAnswer.text: スタートは7営業日、グロースは12営業日です。着手金のお支払いと、ご用意いただくものがそろった日から数えます。

mainEntity.name: どのプラットフォームで作りますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: 主にShopifyで構築します。ご希望があれば、最初の相談でお聞かせください。

mainEntity.name: ショップの所有権は誰にありますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: お客様です。お客様のアカウントで構築し、公開時点からすべてお客様のものになります。

mainEntity.name: 支払い方法を教えてください。

acceptedAnswer.text: ご注文時に50%、残りをショップ公開前にお支払いいただきます。

mainEntity.name: 修正は何回までできますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: スタートは1回、グロースは2回です。それを超える場合は、作業前にお見積もりをお伝えします。

mainEntity.name: BASEやSTORESから移転できますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: はい。ショップ移転のオプションで、商品、顧客リスト、旧URLの転送まで対応します。

mainEntity.name: 定期購入のショップは作れますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: はい。定期購入はグロースに含まれています。

mainEntity.name: 公開後の運営はどうなりますか?

acceptedAnswer.text: ご自身で運営できるようお引き渡しします。更新や毎月の確認を任せたい場合は、保守プランをお選びください。

mainEntity.name: どのプランを選べばよいですか?

acceptedAnswer.text: 商品数が少なければスタート、商品が多い場合や定期購入を始める場合はグロースが合います。迷ったらお気軽にご相談ください。

nook.label: Private workspace
nook.description: A product home page for a private, local-first workspace: white paper, light display type, hairline page rules, soft blooms, black bands and a floating pill of places.

children.text: Nook is a private workspace for teams. Chats, documents and databases live on your devices, so the work stays yours.
Everything is kept on your own devices. Nobody else holds a copy to read.
Share a space with your team. Changes meet up when everyone is back online.
Your work is plain files you can open, move and keep, even without Nook.
Can we move the review to Friday?
Yes. I will update the plan.
Thanks, I will tell the others.
Talk with your team in rooms that keep their own history, and turn any message into a note.
Write pages, link them together and keep each project in its own space.
Keep lists and records you can sort and find again, long after the day has passed.
Your chats, pages and lists are stored on the phone or computer you use.
There is no account to hand over and no server that holds your work.
Whatever leaves your device is scrambled first, and only your team can unscramble it.
Even we cannot read what you send.
Export everything as plain files at any time, in one tap.
Your work never depends on us staying around.
Start with a blank page and add only what you need. Nothing is in the way.
A page is words first. Add headings, lists and links as you go.
Give each row its own fields, and see the same rows in a table, a board or a gallery.
Date, people and what was decided.
Goals, dates and who does what.
What went well and what comes next.
See the same rows your way.

values.alt: A bright room with a table
A cup on a desk
A wooden chair by a wall

children.text: Open, write and search on a plane or a train. Nook never waits for a connection.
When you are back online, changes find their way to your team in moments.
A real app for your phone, not a web page in a frame. It opens at once.
We stopped worrying about where our notes go. They stay on our laptops.
I write on the train with no signal, and everything is there when I get in.
Our whole team moved in an afternoon. The templates did most of the work.
It feels like a calm room. Nothing pings, and nothing is lost.
Make your own corner of the web.
A fictional product, drawn by the Nook library.

children.text: The cranes that dance on snow
Every winter the red-crowned cranes of eastern Hokkaido gather on frozen fields and leap at each other. We spent a week watching them warm up.
Why the robin sings under street lamps
Light, not love, keeps it up at night.
Ten birds you can learn by ear this winter
Start with the wren. It is louder than you think.
The swallows are late. Here is what the logs say
Four thousand first sightings, drawn on one map.
A beginner at the estuary, at low tide
What to bring, where to stand and when to give up.
A life list is every bird one person has met. These three are worth following.

children.text: Proof that you do not need a forest. Counted with coffee, mostly before nine.

children.text: Back on the city canal for the first time in six years.

birdie-species.label: Birdie · Species
birdie-species.description: One species in Birdie: its songs and calls in a player, what it is like, its measures, and the watchers who met it.

values.alt: A robin with an orange breast on a twig

children.text: Erithacus rubecula, one of the Old World flycatchers
Thin call for a hawk overhead
Song at night under a lamp
The robin is the bird that comes to see what you are doing. Dig a bed, turn a compost heap or sit still on a bench, and one will arrive within minutes to check the ground you have disturbed.

Both sexes wear the orange breast and both sing, the female mostly in autumn when each bird holds a winter territory alone. The song is thin, sweet and a little sad, and it is one of the few you can hear in December.
Robins are fierce about their patch. The orange is a warning, and a stuffed robin put in a garden will be attacked by the owner within the hour.
It sat on the fork handle while I dug the potatoes, and left when I did.
Singing at four in the morning by the tram stop. I thought it was a nightingale.
First bird on my list and still the one I look for.

birdie-watcher.description: A watcher’s page in Birdie: their life list as covers with the day and place of each first meeting.

values.alt: Ingrid’s picture: a long-tailed tit

children.text: Bergen, Norway. Watching since 2019, mostly before work and mostly in the rain.

values.alt: A robin with an orange breast on a twig
A black and white oystercatcher with a long orange bill
A grey heron walking through mist
A swallow with a rust-red throat on a pipe
A small brown wren singing with its tail up
A kestrel looking over its shoulder
A goldfinch with a red face and a yellow wing bar
A black and white woodpecker with a red patch, on a trunk
A pinkish-brown jay with a blue wing patch
A mute swan on dark water
A glossy starling speckled with pale spots
A blue and orange kingfisher on a perch
A puffin with a striped bill against the sea
A red-crowned crane bending to the snow
A pale barn owl among yellow flowers
A round white long-tailed tit on a bare branch

children.text: Kingfisher, at last. Six years of looking at that ditch and it was there for four seconds.

Keep a list of your own.
Log the birds you meet, with the day and the place. Your list is yours, and it is free.

birdie-story.label: Birdie · Story
birdie-story.description: One story in Birdie’s Field notes: a headline, a wide photograph, the writing in a reading column and the bird it is about.

children.text: The cranes that dance on snow
Every winter the red-crowned cranes of eastern Hokkaido gather on frozen fields and leap at each other. We spent a week watching them warm up.

values.alt: A red-crowned crane bending to the snow

children.text: A crane feeding at first light, minus eighteen degrees.
You hear them before you see them. A pair calls in unison, one bird starting and the other finishing the same phrase, and the sound carries a mile across the snow.

By eight the field holds sixty cranes. They stand as tall as a ten-year-old, white with black necks and a small red cap that is bare skin, not feathers. In the cold they tuck one leg up and look, from a distance, like a field of tilted lamps.

The dance looks like joy and is partly that. A bird bows, jumps with its wings half open, lands, and throws a stick or a clump of snow in the air. Its partner answers. Pairs stay together for years, and the dance is how they keep it so.
Young birds dance too, badly, with nobody in particular. It is how they learn, and it is the best thing on the field.

A century ago the cranes of Hokkaido were thought to be extinct. A few dozen had survived in a marsh, and in hard winters the farmers nearby began putting out grain. They have not stopped since, and well over a thousand cranes now live on the island.
Come in January or February, and be at the field before sunrise.
Stand still. The birds mind movement far more than they mind people.
Dress for standing, not for walking. It is colder than you think.

values.alt: A red-crowned crane bending to the snow

sections.work:
## Things taking shape

Small ideas become places people can spend time in. These are two of the projects on our table.
sections.approach:
## From a first thought to something real

We start with a conversation and a page of questions. Then we write, sketch and build until the pieces belong together.

### Find the point
What should this help someone do? We keep that question close.

### Make it tangible
A working version gives us something to react to, change and try again.

### Keep making it better
The useful details tend to appear once people begin using it.
sections.contact:
## Have something in mind?

A rough idea is enough to begin. Tell us what you are thinking about, who it is for and what you would like to change.

There is always room for a good conversation.

seed.text:
# A place for what comes next

Bring the words, the shape and the space between them together. A small studio for things worth making.

Make room for a new idea.
